title: USJ Holiday Wonders rope-drop to evening lights · takoyaki · Hozenji lanterns · Jankara nomihodai karaoke

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Out the door by 07:00 with passports, phones charged and the USJ app logged in; grab konbini onigiri and coffee on the way.
stops.transport: Hanshin Namba line Kujō → Nishikujō (1 stop), then JR Yumesaki line → Universal City, about 35 min door to door

stops.name: Universal Studios Japan – Universal Holiday Wonders
stops.plan: At the gate well before opening (official hours for 22 Dec are not confirmed yet, so check the USJ calendar the week before); go straight to Super Nintendo World (get the free timed-entry ticket in the app if you have no Express), use Express Pass slots for Mario Kart/Harry Potter, lunch and an early dinner at the Universal Food Festival, then catch the early Christmas night show and Joy of Lights before leaving.
stops.price: Studio Pass ~¥9,900–11,900 pp (dynamic, buy dated) + Express Pass from ~¥14,800 pp
stops.transport: JR Yumesaki line Universal City → Nishikujō, JR Loop line → Noda, walk to Tamagawa, Metro Sennichimae line → Namba, then walk; about 55 min

stops.name: Takoyaki Wanaka Sennichimae Honten
stops.plan: Takoyaki and the osenbei rice-cracker sandwich to share as the first Osaka bite of the night (it may close around 21:00, so come straight here).
stops.transport: Walk north up Sennichimae to Hozenji, 6 min

stops.name: Hozenji Yokocho
stops.plan: Splash the moss-covered Fudo statue, then first drinks in the lantern-lit stone lane, split into twos and fours across the tiny bars; regroup at the statue.
stops.transport: Walk to Jankara on Dotonbori, 1 min

stops.name: Jankara Dotonbori (BAL UTAO)
stops.plan: All-you-can-drink karaoke lounge or one big room for 8 to close the night, then straight home: tomorrow is the Kyoto day.
stops.price: ¥500 per 30 min with the free Jankara app (¥1,000 without) + 1 food item each
stops.transport: Walk to Osaka-Namba, Hanshin Namba line → Kujō (2 stops), about 35 min door to door
